purpose: Issue #30 external pedestrian-tracking benchmark acquisition contract

datasets.license_or_terms: Review and accept the terms presented by MOTChallenge before download.
datasets.ground_truth_policy: Only splits with locally available official ground truth may be used for target selection or correctness evaluation.

scene_deduplication.scene_key_rule: Remove the final detector suffix from MOT17-XX-SUFFIX.
scene_deduplication.reason: The three detector-labelled folders represent the same underlying image scene. Issue #30 must not count them as three independent sequences.

datasets.public_detection_policy: Ignore MOT17 public detections for detector-ByteTrack mode. Use the thesis detector output. The canonical variant only identifies one non-duplicated image/ground-truth folder.

datasets.license_or_terms: Annotations are CC BY 4.0. Dataset images and videos are available for non-commercial research only. Review the official agreement before download.
datasets.ground_truth_policy: Only splits containing official local ground-truth identities may be selected.

scene_deduplication.scene_key_rule: Use the official sequence directory name.
scene_deduplication.reason: No MOT17-style detector-folder duplication is expected.

datasets.public_detection_policy: Not used. Oracle mode uses official ground truth; end-to-end mode uses the thesis detector and ByteTrack.

datasets.license_or_terms: Review the official VisDrone repository and download terms before acquisition.
datasets.ground_truth_policy: Use only official multi-object-tracking splits with identity annotations. Test splits without released ground truth are not admissible for target correctness.

scene_deduplication.reason: No MOT17-style detector-folder duplication is expected.

datasets.public_detection_policy: Not used. Oracle mode uses official ground truth; end-to-end mode uses the thesis detector and ByteTrack.
